leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a TypeScript interface to define the structure of mock data
Implement a basic mock data builder function with typed parameters
Apply optional chaining and default values to handle partial data in builders
Configure a builder with method chaining for fluent API patterns
Manipulate builder methods to generate variations of mock data instances
Integrate the mock data builder into a testing or development workflow
Update existing data structures with incremental builder modifications
